nodes.label: Five Layer Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Separately compiled layers enforce downward dependencies because higher-layer types do not yet exist.

nodes.label: Managed
nodes.rationale: Use Managed for script-only classes so weak observers are nulled instead of becoming dangling pointers.

nodes.label: Lantern
nodes.rationale: Fictional teaching framework with original examples; it is not a published mod.

nodes.label: Reference Cycles
nodes.rationale: Owner-to-child references are strong; child-to-owner references are weak so ARC can release both.

nodes.label: Init Pattern
nodes.rationale: One parameterless constructor per class plus explicit Init methods avoids incompatible constructor signatures.

nodes.label: Guard Clauses

nodes.label: vector.DistanceSq
nodes.rationale: Squared distance comparisons avoid expensive square roots in frequent proximity checks.

nodes.label: Class Prefixes
nodes.rationale: Script class names are globally shared even when files are organized in separate mod directories.

nodes.label: Server Authority
nodes.rationale: Validate client requests server-side so clients cannot authorize game-state changes.

nodes.label: Widget Pooling
nodes.rationale: Reuse list widgets to avoid repeated allocation and layout recalculation during frequent updates.

nodes.label: Multi-PBO Builds
nodes.rationale: Separate fast script rebuilds from expensive asset binarization and split archives before size limits.

nodes.label: Bounding sphere
nodes.rationale: The bounding volume must encompass open doors or action raycasts and ballistic collision can miss them.

nodes.label: Mod-prefixed translation keys
nodes.rationale: Loaded PBO stringtables merge into a global table; a unique mod prefix prevents collisions.

nodes.label: Texture atlas
nodes.rationale: A shared texture serves many named icon regions, reducing separate texture loads and memory overhead.

nodes.label: cfgeconomycore.xml
nodes.rationale: Register separate mod economy files through ce directives so admins need not modify vanilla files and additions survive updates.

nodes.label: Spawn gear presets
nodes.rationale: Valid presets bypass StartingEquipSetup; malformed JSON in any registered preset disables the entire preset system for that session.

nodes.label: Deferred entity deletion
nodes.rationale: Object.Delete schedules removal for the next frame to avoid deleting objects during iteration or event processing.

nodes.label: MissionWeather
nodes.rationale: Manual weather mode disables automatic transitions so scripts can own deterministic weather changes.

nodes.label: ScriptCamera
nodes.rationale: The chapter notes ScriptCamera is guarded by GAME_TEMPLATE and absent from the DayZ build; use the engine Camera or FreeDebugCamera APIs.

nodes.label: LNT_Notify
nodes.rationale: Teaching wrapper standardizes severity, icon, guard and duration while preserving vanilla notification delivery.

nodes.label: Callback cleanup
nodes.rationale: Remove scheduled callbacks and unsubscribe listeners before their owners are destroyed to prevent dangling method calls.

nodes.label: Server-side validation
nodes.rationale: Validate RPC sender identity, target ownership and value ranges before server-authoritative changes.

nodes.label: EEOnCECreate
nodes.rationale: Fires for fresh CE or debug spawns, not persistence reloads or ordinary script-created entities.

nodes.label: Idempotent connection initialization
nodes.rationale: The source reports repeated InvokeOnConnect calls; guard already-loaded player data so the second call does not overwrite cached changes or repeat grants.

nodes.label: ActionData
nodes.rationale: Running action context holds player, main item, target and progress component; shared action singletons must not hold per-execution state.

nodes.label: Health pools
nodes.rationale: Player health, blood and shock are distinct survival pools; state changes are authoritative on the server.

nodes.label: ParticleManager
nodes.rationale: Pool owns ParticleSource lifetime; render effects on clients and clean high-level SEffectManager registrations.

nodes.label: LNT_AutoConfigPlugin
nodes.rationale: Module lifecycle rules forbid config loading in OnInit, while the same chapter self-loading plugin example performs it there. Startup policy needs reconciliation.

nodes.label: ChatInputMenu
nodes.rationale: Intercept completed slash-command input before vanilla ChatPlayer broadcast; route authoritative execution to server.

nodes.label: CfgRecipes
nodes.rationale: Custom item tutorial suggests CfgRecipes config registration; the dedicated crafting chapter specifies RecipeBase subclasses and RegisterRecipies. Treat this tutorial suggestion as unresolved.

nodes.label: Mod scaffold
nodes.rationale: Correct layer registration and consistent mod paths prevent silent script loading failures.

nodes.label: Dedicated server testing
nodes.rationale: Separate server and client processes reveal RPC authority, timing and missing-identity issues that a listen server can hide.

nodes.label: biprivatekey
nodes.rationale: Keep the private signing key out of the public release and retain the same key for compatible updates.

nodes.label: MyModManager
nodes.rationale: A singleton centralizes mission state; initialization guards and shutdown cleanup prevent duplicate active managers.

nodes.label: MyModConfig
nodes.rationale: Public defaults remain useful when older configuration files omit newly introduced fields.

nodes.label: MFM_RallyHatchback
nodes.rationale: Extending a vanilla vehicle preserves its model rig, animations and underlying simulation while customizing behavior and appearance.

nodes.label: MCM_TacticalJacket_ColorBase
nodes.rationale: A hidden common base shares clothing properties while public concrete variants select textures.

nodes.label: heatIsolation
nodes.rationale: Actual warmth also depends on clothing condition and wetness, beyond the base insulation value.

nodes.label: ShopItem
nodes.rationale: Keeping the sell price below the buy price prevents a profitable buy-sell loop.

nodes.label: ShopDemoRPC
nodes.rationale: The tutorial delimiter format is fragile when labels contain delimiters; structured serialization is recommended for production.

nodes.label: count_in_hoarder
nodes.rationale: Counting stashed high-value items makes hoarding suppress replenishment instead of multiplying rare loot.

nodes.label: Backup Strategy
nodes.rationale: Stop the server before copying persistence; keep multiple generations off-machine so mid-save corruption and disk failure do not destroy every copy.

nodes.label: Idle Mode
nodes.rationale: Pause economy work when the server is empty to avoid unnecessary spawn cycles.

nodes.label: -serverMod launch option
nodes.rationale: Keep server-only logic in -servermod when clients require no assets or scripts from the package.
